create_security.ponder.basic_sight_senso: The Sight Sensor can be used to detect when entities are looking at it.
It outputs a redstone signal depending on how far the entity is.
Right-click the back with a wrench to reverse the signal.
If you are holding a wrench, you can also change the range of the sight sensor.
create_security.ponder.finiranium_end_si: Finiranium is a powerful mineral from the end; It can be found in End Midlands.
However, it is not safe to be around.
Being around Finiranium products can build up End Sickness.
End Sickness slowly drains your health as you remain around finiranium, so heed the warnings in the chat.
